name: srvname-dns-only-permit-valid
description: RFC 4985 §4: an SRVName constraint with only a DNS name part (example.com - no _Service prefix) permits any SRVName SAN whose DNS part falls under that subtree. The matching rule is the same left-hand-side label-addition rule used for dNSName. A SAN of _mail.example.com therefore satisfies the permit example.com.
notes: RFC 4985 §4: 'If the restriction has an absent service name, then that restriction is satisfied by any SRVName that matches the domain part of the restriction.'
